input: Write weekly affirmations in a dedicated journal

gold.taskTitle: Start a Weekly Affirmations Journaling Practice
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to write weekly affirmations in a dedicated journal as a regular habit.

questions.title: What day of the week will you write your affirmations?
questions.description: Identify the specific day the user plans to sit down and write each week.

questions.title: Do you already own a journal set aside for this?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a physical journal ready or still needs to get one.

questions.title: How many affirmations do you want to write each session?
questions.description: Clarify the target volume of affirmations per weekly sitting.

questions.title: What area of life will the affirmations focus on?
questions.description: Identify the theme or domain the affirmations should address, such as career, health, relationships, or self-worth.

questions.title: Will you write your own affirmations or use existing ones?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to craft original affirmations or draw from a source like a book or website.

questions.title: What time of day feels most natural for this practice?
questions.description: Pin down whether the user prefers morning, evening, or another time slot for writing.

questions.title: How will you track whether you kept up the habit?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a tracking method such as a checklist, reminder, or accountability partner.
